3c76e7818a3ed34c.src: Hazard perception is about spotting risks early. The app plays 72 short driving clips in real-time 3D, seen from the driver's seat: you are told what you want to do (turn right, move off, overtake, change lanes or slow down) and tap when it becomes safe, in the same style as the hazard perception tests. Clips cover suburban streets, traffic lights, roundabouts, school zones, country roads with kangaroos and road trains, freeways, level crossings and Melbourne trams, by day, at dusk, at night and in the rain. Afterwards a timeline shows when it was safe and when you tapped, with the road rule explained, and you can watch the clip again.
3c76e7818a3ed34c.t: 危险感知的关键在于及早发现风险。App 会播放 72 段以驾驶座视角呈现的实时 3D 驾驶短片：先告诉你要做什么（右转、起步、超车、变道或减速），等到安全时你再点击屏幕，方式与危险感知测试相同。短片涵盖市郊街道、红绿灯、环岛、学校区域、有袋鼠出没和公路列车（road train）行驶的乡村道路、高速公路、铁路道口和墨尔本有轨电车，场景包括白天、黄昏、夜间和雨天。结束后，时间轴会显示什么时候安全、你什么时候点击，并解释相关的交通规则，你还可以重看短片。

d3a81724616142ba.src: There are also 40 illustrated still scenes where you tap the hazard. 11 clips and 6 scenes are free, and Premium unlocks them all. Every clip and scene can be browsed in picture libraries, and any clip can be replayed. Each state's licence guide explains where its hazard perception test fits on the way to your P plates (the Northern Territory has no separate test: hazards are assessed in the practical driving test). The clips and scenes are original practice material, not a copy of any official test. <t0>Read our hazard perception guide</t0>.
d3a81724616142ba.t: 此外还有 40 幅插图形式的静态场景，你需要点击其中的危险。其中 11 段短片和 6 个场景免费，Premium 可解锁全部内容。所有短片和场景都可以在图片库中浏览，任何短片都可以重播。每个州的驾照指南都会说明，在考取 P 牌的过程中，该州的危险感知测试处于哪个环节（北领地没有单独的测试：危险识别会在路考中评估）。这些短片和场景是原创练习材料，并非复制任何官方考试。<t0>阅读我们的危险感知指南</t0>。

49e326081ee56adc.src: Every state and territory sets its own learner knowledge test. Formats range from 30 questions (Queensland, the Tasmanian online test, the Northern Territory and South Australia's myLs) through 32 in Victoria's in-person test and 35 in the ACT to 45 in the NSW DKT and 50 in South Australia's in-person test, and several states also offer an online course route. Learners Test Australia has practice for all eight: New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, South Australia, Western Australia, Tasmania, the Australian Capital Territory and the Northern Territory.

169846570e8be1a8.src: What is the same in every state?

f48b1d2d68b46680.src: Much of what the tests check comes from the national Australian Road Rules, which most states and territories adopt in their own law (Western Australia has its own Road Traffic Code, which follows them closely): giving way at intersections and roundabouts, traffic lights, speed limit signs and most road markings. The details that differ are usually licensing rules (supervised hours, plate rules, passenger limits, alcohol and phone rules for new drivers) and a few local road rules, such as Victoria's hook turns or the Northern Territory's 130 km/h roads. Our guide to <t0>give way rules</t0> covers the shared rules.
f48b1d2d68b46680.t: 考试考查的很多内容来自全国性的 Australian Road Rules（澳大利亚道路规则），大多数州和领地都将其纳入本地法律（西澳有自己的 Road Traffic Code，与其高度一致）：包括在路口和环岛让行、红绿灯、限速标志和大多数道路标线。不同之处通常在于驾照规定（陪练驾驶时数、L/P 牌规定、乘客人数限制，以及针对新司机的酒精和手机规定）和少数地方交通规则，例如维多利亚州的钩形转弯，或北领地限速 130 km/h 的道路。我们的<t0>让行规则</t0>指南介绍了这些共同规则。

54f5ef80b2e766fb.src: Is Learners Test Australia an official government app?

The official test is run by your state or territory's licensing authority, so always check its current handbook and website.
be634d8676dd4c7b.t: 不是。Learners Test Australia 是一款独立的学习 App。它不隶属于澳大利亚任何州或领地政府、驾照管理机构或其他政府机构，未获得它们的认可，也与它们没有任何关联。正式考试由你所在州或领地的驾照管理机构主办，所以请务必查看其最新的手册和网站。

97c4397198197d63.src: Are these the real test questions?

e294012c7163f94a.src: No. Every question is written for the app in our own words. The questions test the same facts the official material covers, but no official questions, answer options, handbook text or images are reproduced.
e294012c7163f94a.t: 不是。每道题都是我们为这款 App 用自己的语言编写的。这些题目考查的知识点与官方资料涵盖的内容相同，但没有复制任何官方题目、答案选项、手册文字或图片。

923ba575e0e01ff5.t: 全部八个：新南威尔士州、维多利亚州、昆士兰州、南澳（南澳大利亚州）、西澳（西澳大利亚州）、塔斯马尼亚州、首都领地（澳大利亚首都领地）和北领地。每个州和领地都有自己的题库、模拟考试和驾照指南，你可以随时切换州。<t0>按州对比考试</t0>。

9cd94894fa6a4c6a.src: The NSW Driver Knowledge Test (45 questions: 15 general knowledge, pass 12, and 30 road safety, pass 29), the Victorian learner permit test (32 questions, pass 25), the Queensland written road rules test (10 giving way, pass 9, and 20 road rules, pass 18) and PrepL final test (30 questions, pass 27), the South Australian learner's theory test (8 give-way questions, all must be right, then 42, pass 32) and myLs test (30 questions, pass 27), a 30-question Western Australian practice test, the Tasmanian online driver knowledge test (30 questions, pass 27), a 35-question ACT practice test (pass line 31) and the Northern Territory driver knowledge test (30 questions, pass 26). There is also hazard perception practice with real-time 3D driving clips and still scenes.
9cd94894fa6a4c6a.t: NSW Driver Knowledge Test（共 45 题：一般知识 15 题，答对 12 题及格；道路安全 30 题，答对 29 题及格）、维多利亚州学习驾照笔试（32 题，答对 25 题及格）、昆士兰州交通规则笔试（让行 10 题，答对 9 题及格；交通规则 20 题，答对 18 题及格）和 PrepL 最终测试（30 题，答对 27 题及格）、南澳学习驾照理论考试（8 道让行题必须全部答对，然后再答 42 题，答对 32 题及格）和 myLs 测试（30 题，答对 27 题及格）、一套 30 题的西澳练习测试、塔斯马尼亚州在线交规笔试（30 题，答对 27 题及格）、一套 35 题的 ACT 练习测试（及格线 31 题）以及北领地交规笔试（30 题，答对 26 题及格）。此外还有危险感知练习，包括实时 3D 驾驶短片和静态场景。

ac787a66c4cba297.src: Yes. It is free to download and every practice question is free. Free learners get one mock test a day, plus another each time they choose to watch a short ad. The free version shows banner ads on results and guide pages.

We don't sell your name, email address or study data. Details are in the <t0>privacy policy</t0>.
88383706917e5043.t: 登录时提供的姓名和电子邮件地址；你的学习数据（答题记录、学习时段、收藏的题目和所选的州）；只有在你允许的情况下才会收集的使用统计和崩溃报告（不与你的姓名或电子邮件关联）；以及在免费版中用于广告的设备广告 ID。我们不会出售你的姓名、电子邮件地址或学习数据。详情请见<t0>隐私政策</t0>。

a91cb3e79f52cdd7.src: After your first 12 answers (the quick check), the app estimates your chance of passing from your recent answers. It is an estimate, not a guarantee. Premium adds a forecast for each section of the test.
a91cb3e79f52cdd7.t: 答完前 12 题（快速摸底）后，App 会根据你最近的答题情况估算你的通过概率。这只是估算，不是保证。Premium 还会增加考试每个部分的预测。

0abe3cd09338056d.src: Does the app include hazard perception practice?
0abe3cd09338056d.t: App 有危险感知练习吗？

951188f93e5a5e5d.src: Yes. 4f53733f836c190c.src: Why a state-by-state learner test app?
4f53733f836c190c.t: 为什么要做按州区分的学习驾照笔试 App？

e96f0c9169b645d4.src: Each state runs its own knowledge test with its own format, pass marks and licensing rules. A question bank that mixes them up teaches the wrong numbers: the supervised hours, plate rules and alcohol limits for new drivers are not the same everywhere. So the app has one profile per state, and each profile follows that state's handbook, test format and rules.
e96f0c9169b645d4.t: 每个州都有自己的交规笔试，考试形式、及格线和驾照规定各不相同。把各州混在一起的题库会教给你错误的数字：陪练驾驶时数、L/P 牌规定和新司机的酒精限制，并不是各地都一样。所以 App 为每个州设置单独的档案，每个档案都遵循该州的手册、考试形式和规定。

21c419b91834a9b5.src: We list every fact the official material tests, using the current handbook, the official test pages, the official practice tests (only to see which facts get tested) and the road rules legislation. For Western Australia, Tasmania, the ACT and the Northern Territory we work from legislation instead of a handbook. Each fact records its source and the date it was checked.
21c419b91834a9b5.t: 我们列出官方资料考查的每一个知识点，依据包括现行手册、官方考试页面、官方练习题（仅用于了解哪些知识点会考）和交通规则法规。对于西澳、塔斯马尼亚州、ACT 和北领地，我们依据法规而非手册。每个知识点都记录了出处和核对日期。

81f29367e0f27d44.src: Every question is written in our own words to test one fact from the map, with wrong options based on common misunderstandings. No official question, answer option, handbook sentence or image is reproduced, and we don't paraphrase official question banks.
81f29367e0f27d44.t: 每道题都用我们自己的语言编写，考查覆盖图中的一个知识点，错误选项则根据常见的误解设计。我们不复制任何官方题目、答案选项、手册语句或图片，也不改写官方题库。

036588d4c607eb99.src: A source and a review date on every question

097f058034708946.src: Each question carries the handbook page or road rule it comes from and the date it was last verified. The launch packs were checked on 30 September 2026.
097f058034708946.t: 每道题都附有其出处的手册页码或交通规则条文，以及最近一次核实的日期。首发题库于 2026 年 9 月 30 日核对。

65f2b0454f46b6f0.src: Where an older official source differs from the current rule, the question follows the current rule. Facts we couldn't confirm from a current official source are flagged for manual checking rather than turned into questions.
65f2b0454f46b6f0.t: 如果较早的官方资料与现行规则不一致，题目以现行规则为准。无法通过现行官方资料确认的知识点会被标记出来，留待人工核查，而不会被编成题目。

e463554ce1f6cb4c.src: The NSW Driver Knowledge Test (DKT) is the multiple-choice test you pass to get a learner licence in New South Wales. The format published by the NSW Government is 45 questions in two sections: 15 general knowledge questions, where you need 12 correct, and 30 road safety questions, where you need 29 correct. There is no time limit, and the test ends as soon as passing is no longer possible.
e463554ce1f6cb4c.t: NSW Driver Knowledge Test（DKT，交规笔试）是一项选择题考试，在新南威尔士州考取学习驾照（L 牌）必须通过。根据 NSW 政府公布的形式，考试共 45 题，分为两部分：15 道一般知识题，需答对 12 题；30 道道路安全题，需答对 29 题。考试没有时间限制，一旦已经不可能及格，考试就会立即结束。

cb78d0a5bff98b57.src: How many questions are in the NSW DKT, and what is the pass mark?
cb78d0a5bff98b57.t: NSW DKT 有多少题？及格线是多少？

cf6dfb4dd7b64ba1.src: The in-person DKT is a computer test with questions drawn at random from a question bank. It has two parts, and you must pass both. In the 15-question general knowledge part you can afford 3 mistakes. In the 30-question road safety part you can afford only 1. That makes road safety the part to take most seriously: two slips and the test is over, however well the rest went.
cf6dfb4dd7b64ba1.t: 现场 DKT 在电脑上进行，题目从题库中随机抽取。考试分两部分，两部分都必须通过。15 题的一般知识部分最多可以错 3 题；30 题的道路安全部分只能错 1 题。所以道路安全部分最需要认真对待：只要错两题，考试就结束了，其他部分答得再好也没用。

f8cf7705d9b0aa54.src: The NSW Government sets out this 45-question structure on its knowledge test pages (it is spelled out on the rider knowledge test page), and the car DKT is reported to use the same structure. Check the official DKT page when you book.
f8cf7705d9b0aa54.t: NSW 政府在其笔试相关页面上列出了这个 45 题的结构（摩托车笔试页面上写得最明确），据报道小汽车 DKT 也采用相同的结构。预约时请查看官方 DKT 页面。

d7b5d8fd4b0b25a5.src: Can you do the DKT online?

413b9755074795b0.src: Yes. Since 2024 NSW has offered the DKT online: a course of about 4 to 6 hours with a final test at the end, open from 15 years and 11 months. The NSW Government does not publish the number of questions or the pass mark for the online final test. Both versions are built on the Road User Handbook, so the same study covers either route.
413b9755074795b0.t: 可以。自 2024 年起，NSW 推出了 DKT 网上考试：一门约 4 到 6 小时的课程，课程结束时有一场最终测试，年满 15 岁 11 个月即可参加。NSW 政府没有公布网上最终测试的题目数量和及格线。两种方式都以 Road User Handbook（道路使用者手册）为基础，所以同样的复习两种途径都适用。

00f9f13e4e0059db.src: What topics are in the NSW DKT?

cb22cb677d23e15f.src: The DKT covers the Road User Handbook: licences, safe driving (speed, alcohol, drugs, seatbelts, phones and fatigue), sharing the road with pedestrians, cyclists and heavy vehicles, stopping, giving way and turning, overtaking and merging, lanes and markings, parking, hazards, vehicle safety and penalties. In the NSW Government's published 2018 question list, the topics with the most questions were pedestrians, intersections and giving way, traffic signs, safe following and stopping distances, and traffic lights.
cb22cb677d23e15f.t: DKT 的考试范围是 Road User Handbook 的内容：驾照、安全驾驶（车速、酒精、毒品、安全带、手机和疲劳驾驶）、与行人、骑自行车者和重型车辆共享道路、停车、让行与转弯、超车与并道、车道与标线、泊车、危险情况、车辆安全以及处罚。在 NSW 政府公布的 2018 年题目清单中，题目最多的主题是行人、路口与让行、交通标志、安全跟车距离与刹停距离，以及交通信号灯。

0a25deec7f5e2b4a.src: A few NSW rules that learners often get wrong:
0a25deec7f5e2b4a.t: 学车者常弄错的几条 NSW 规则：

3d1e7b244c5a698c.src: Learner, P1 and P2 drivers must have a zero blood alcohol concentration.
3d1e7b244c5a698c.t: L 牌、P1 和 P2 司机的血液酒精浓度必须为零。

b97236f1f599fb73.src: Learner, P1 and P2 drivers may not use a phone at all while driving, not even hands-free or when stopped at lights.
b97236f1f599fb73.t: L 牌、P1 和 P2 司机开车时完全不得使用手机，即使是免提或在红绿灯前停车时也不行。

40de0fabea0390a6.src: Learner and P1 drivers may not go faster than 90 km/h, and P2 drivers 100 km/h, even where signs allow more.
40de0fabea0390a6.t: L 牌和 P1 司机车速不得超过 90 km/h，P2 司机不得超过 100 km/h，即使限速标志允许更快也不行。

1db420b285273dbc.src: L plates go on the outside of the car, front and back (or on a roof sign), with the whole letter visible.
1db420b285273dbc.t: L 牌要挂在车外的前后两侧（或装在车顶标志上），整个字母必须完整可见。

68c38d2e7e9c406a.src: Learners may not drive in Sydney's Moore Park, Centennial Park or Parramatta Park.
68c38d2e7e9c406a.t: 学车者不得在悉尼的 Moore Park（摩尔公园）、Centennial Park（百年纪念公园）或 Parramatta Park（帕拉马塔公园）内驾驶。

56fcec4e2ca03cfe.src: In good conditions, keep at least a 3-second gap to the vehicle ahead.
56fcec4e2ca03cfe.t: 在路况良好时，与前车至少保持 3 秒的车距。

602cb0f26032f4eb.src: What happens after you pass the DKT?
602cb0f26032f4eb.t: 通过 DKT 之后要做什么？

3ff84ffe7b42c4ba.src: You get a learner licence, valid for 5 years (if it expires, you must pass the DKT again). If you are under 25, you need to hold it for at least 12 months and log at least 120 hours of supervised driving, 20 of them at night, before the driving test. The Safer Drivers Course earns 20 bonus hours, and each hour-long lesson with a licensed instructor can be logged as 3 hours. Your supervisor must hold a full Australian licence and sit beside you.
3ff84ffe7b42c4ba.t: 你会获得学习驾照，有效期 5 年（如果过期，必须重新通过 DKT）。如果你未满 25 岁，在参加路考前必须持有学习驾照至少 12 个月，并记录至少 120 小时的陪练驾驶，其中 20 小时须在夜间。完成 Safer Drivers Course（安全驾驶课程）可获得 20 小时奖励时数，跟持牌教练上的每节一小时课程可记为 3 小时。你的陪练人必须持有澳大利亚正式驾照，并坐在你旁边。

484775df28905acb.src: Next comes the Hazard Perception Test: if you are under 25, you can sit it only after at least 10 months on your Ls, and a pass stays valid for 15 months for the driving test. Our <t0>hazard perception guide</t0> explains what it tests.
484775df28905acb.t: 接下来是危险感知测试（Hazard Perception Test）：如果你未满 25 岁，必须持 L 牌至少 10 个月后才能参加；通过后的成绩在 15 个月内可用于参加路考。我们的<t0>危险感知指南</t0>介绍了这项测试考什么。

39de5a1d493912e5.src: How many questions are in the NSW DKT?

27dd7e5f6ebac7ff.src: The format published by the NSW Government is 45 multiple-choice questions: 15 general knowledge questions, where you need 12 correct, and 30 road safety questions, where you need 29 correct.
27dd7e5f6ebac7ff.t: 根据 NSW 政府公布的形式，考试共 45 道选择题：15 道一般知识题，需答对 12 题；30 道道路安全题，需答对 29 题。

f5da0ed59bd1078b.src: How many questions can you get wrong in the DKT?

67a1eca7fb2454ae.src: Up to 3 in the general knowledge section and 1 in the road safety section. A 4th wrong answer in general knowledge, or a 2nd in road safety, ends the test.
67a1eca7fb2454ae.t: 一般知识部分最多错 3 题，道路安全部分最多错 1 题。一般知识部分答错第 4 题，或道路安全部分答错第 2 题，考试即结束。

78d1d06ad3acde6c.src: How many questions are in the Victorian learner permit test?
78d1d06ad3acde6c.t: 维多利亚州学习驾照笔试有多少题？

5988a01fb82534a3.src: The in-person test has 32 multiple-choice questions, each with three options, and you need at least 25 right. That figure comes from VicRoads' practice test page, which says its practice test has the same size and pass mark as the real one. VicRoads doesn't publish the size or pass mark of the online course's final test, so the app's mock follows the in-person format.
5988a01fb82534a3.t: 现场考试共 32 道选择题，每题三个选项，至少需答对 25 题。这个数字来自 VicRoads 的练习测试页面，该页面说明其练习测试与正式考试的题量和及格线相同。VicRoads 没有公布网上课程最终测试的题量或及格线，因此本应用的模拟考试采用现场考试的形式。

6ca402bb316a7286.src: Online course or in person: which applies to you?
6ca402bb316a7286.t: 网上课程还是现场考试：哪种适合你？

a4c46a3b8eb43564.src: The online learner permit course is now the standard route. It takes about 4 to 6 hours, is in English only, and you have 12 months to finish it; the first attempt at the final test is free.
a4c46a3b8eb43564.t: 网上学习驾照课程现在是标准途径。课程约需 4 到 6 小时，仅有英文，你有 12 个月时间完成；最终测试首次参加免费。

d756da2af56a2591.src: Sitting the test in person at a VicRoads Customer Service Centre is for people who need another language or an interpreter, or who have no computer or internet access, and an appointment fee applies. VicRoads offers the in-person test in 13 languages: Arabic, Chinese (Mandarin), Vietnamese, Turkish, Persian, Cambodian, Sinhalese, Somali, Albanian, Macedonian, Russian, Serbian and Spanish. If yours isn't listed, a free interpreter can be booked, including Auslan. Allow about 45 minutes: the eyesight test and permit application happen at the same visit.
d756da2af56a2591.t: 在 VicRoads Customer Service Centre（客户服务中心）参加现场考试，适用于需要其他语言或口译员、或无法使用电脑或网络的人，需支付预约费。VicRoads 提供 13 种语言的现场考试：阿拉伯语、中文（普通话）、越南语、土耳其语、波斯语、柬埔寨语、僧伽罗语、索马里语、阿尔巴尼亚语、马其顿语、俄语、塞尔维亚语和西班牙语。如果你的语言不在其中，可以免费预约口译员，包括 Auslan（澳大利亚手语）。请预留约 45 分钟：视力检查和学习驾照申请会在同一次到访时完成。

20b59eb45facf0b2.src: What does the learner permit test cover?
20b59eb45facf0b2.t: 学习驾照笔试考哪些内容？

34c34a76d3e66384.src: The test draws on the whole Road to Solo Driving handbook: the licensing section and its four chapters on the challenges of driving, learning to drive, managing risk, and rules and responsibilities. In the VicRoads practice test, the topics that come up most are giving way, learning to drive and hazard perception, parking, speed limits and pedestrians (from our review of the practice test on 30 September 2026). The handbook itself warns that the practice test doesn't cover everything.
34c34a76d3e66384.t: 考题涵盖整本 Road to Solo Driving 手册：驾照部分，以及驾驶的挑战、学习驾驶、风险管理、规则与责任这四章。在 VicRoads 的练习测试中，出现最多的主题是让行、学习驾驶与危险感知、泊车、限速和行人（根据我们于 2026 年 9 月 30 日对练习测试的检查）。手册本身也提醒，练习测试并未涵盖全部内容。

69324c035f341769.src: Victoria has some rules you won't find in other states' tests:
69324c035f341769.t: 维多利亚州有一些其他州考试里没有的规则：

42243dfbc2843448.src: <t0>Hook turns:</t0> at intersections with a hook turn sign, mainly in central Melbourne, you turn right from the far-left lane and wait near the far side until the lights for the road you're entering turn green.
42243dfbc2843448.t: <t0>钩形转弯（hook turn）：</t0>在设有 hook turn 标志的路口（主要在墨尔本市中心），你要从最左侧车道右转，并在路口对侧附近等候，直到你要驶入的道路的信号灯变绿。

682b3ed6026be646.src: <t0>Trams:</t0> when a tram stops at a stop with no safety zone, stop at the back of the tram without going past it, and don't pass while the doors are open. Once the doors close and nobody is on the road, you may pass at no more than 10 km/h.
682b3ed6026be646.t: <t0>有轨电车：</t0>当有轨电车停靠在没有安全区的站点时，你必须在电车尾部后方停车，不得越过；车门打开时不得驶过电车。车门关闭且路面上没有行人后，你才可以以不超过 10 km/h 的速度驶过。

4f49064a48bdaea9.src: <t0>Phones for L and P drivers:</t0> a phone may only be used in a commercially made mounting for navigation or audio set up before the trip, without touching it. No calls at all, not even hands-free.
4f49064a48bdaea9.t: <t0>L 牌和 P 牌司机使用手机：</t0>手机只能固定在商业生产的手机支架上，用于出发前已设置好的导航或音频，并且不得触碰。完全不能打电话，即使免提也不行。

22e6ada6f528b2f7.src: Other learner rules to know: you must have a zero blood alcohol concentration; L plates go on the front and rear, visible from 20 metres; learners must not tow; and your supervisor sits in the front passenger seat, holds a full licence, must be under 0.05 and must not drink at all while supervising.
22e6ada6f528b2f7.t: 其他需要了解的 L 牌规则：你的血液酒精浓度必须为零；L 牌要挂在车辆前后，并在 20 米外清晰可见；学车者不得拖车；你的陪练人须坐在副驾驶座，持有正式驾照，血液酒精浓度必须低于 0.05，并且在陪练期间完全不得饮酒。

6e2652e0350039c2.src: What happens after you get your learner permit?
6e2652e0350039c2.t: 拿到学习驾照之后要做什么？

d43dc2b4587befba.src: Your permit lasts 10 years. If you'll be under 21 at your licence test, you need at least 120 hours of supervised driving, 20 or more after dark, recorded in the myLearners app or the Learner Log Book. From 21 no log book is required. You must hold the permit for at least 12 months if under 21, 6 months if 21 to under 25, and 3 months if 25 or older. The Hazard Perception Test comes before the drive test and can be taken from 17 years 11 months, and the probationary licence is available from 18.
d43dc2b4587befba.t: 学习驾照有效期 10 年。如果你参加驾照路考时未满 21 岁，需要至少 120 小时的陪练驾驶，其中 20 小时或以上须在天黑后，并记录在 myLearners 应用或 Learner Log Book（学车驾驶日志）中。年满 21 岁则无需驾驶日志。未满 21 岁须持学习驾照至少 12 个月，21 岁至未满 25 岁须至少 6 个月，25 岁或以上须至少 3 个月。危险感知测试（Hazard Perception Test）在路考之前进行，年满 17 岁 11 个月即可参加；年满 18 岁可申领 P 牌试用驾照。

ab15619f2de48128.src: In Queensland you can qualify for a car learner licence in one of two ways: the written road rules test, sat on paper at a licence-issuing centre, or PrepL, an online course with a final test. The written test has 30 multiple-choice questions in two separately scored sections: giving way (10 questions, need 9) and road rules and licence requirements (20 questions, need 18). The PrepL final test has 30 questions and you need 27 (90%).
ab15619f2de48128.t: 在昆士兰州，你可以通过两种方式之一取得小汽车学习驾照（L 牌）资格：一是在驾照签发中心用纸笔作答的 written road rules test（纸质交规笔试），二是 PrepL，一门含最终测试的网上课程。纸质笔试共 30 道选择题，分两部分分别计分：让行（10 题，需答对 9 题）以及道路规则与驾照要求（20 题，需答对 18 题）。PrepL 最终测试共 30 题，需答对 27 题（90%）。

ea237d0c4805854c.t: 约 4–6 小时的网上课程，之后是 30 题的最终测试；30 题中答对 27 题及格（90%）

68d860ee9adccb69.t: Your keys to driving in Queensland（昆士兰州驾驶手册，第 19 版，2022 年 11 月），以及现行规则

f296086ae70bead6.src: How many questions are in the QLD written road rules test?
f296086ae70bead6.t: QLD 纸质交规笔试有多少题？

d7df018a0f178863.src: Thirty, in two sections that are scored separately. The giving-way section has 10 questions and you can afford only one mistake. The road rules and licence requirements section has 20 questions and you can afford two. A strong score in one section can't make up for a weak one in the other. No formal time limit is published; the handbook suggests allowing at least 30 minutes.
d7df018a0f178863.t: 30 题，分两部分分别计分。让行部分 10 题，只能错一题；道路规则与驾照要求部分 20 题，可以错两题。一个部分考得好，不能弥补另一个部分的不足。官方没有公布正式的时间限制；手册建议预留至少 30 分钟。

e80ec95fe7b265e4.src: What is PrepL, and how is it different?
e80ec95fe7b265e4.t: PrepL 是什么？有什么不同？

f9270e753d0db249.src: PrepL is Queensland's online learning and assessment course. It takes about 4 to 6 hours on a phone, tablet or computer and has three sections: Your driving attitude, Signs and rules, and Sharing the road. Assessment pieces are built in, and the final test has 30 questions with a pass mark of 27. You can enrol from 15 years and 11 months, so your learner licence can be issued on your 16th birthday. PrepL isn't compulsory yet: until it is, you can choose either route. Letting someone else do your PrepL can see your enrolment cancelled, a penalty of more than $6,900 for them, and a 6-month wait before you can enrol again. Our guide compares <t0>the written test and PrepL side by side</t0>.
f9270e753d0db249.t: PrepL 是昆士兰州的网上学习与考核课程。在手机、平板或电脑上学习约需 4 到 6 小时，分为三个部分：Your driving attitude（你的驾驶态度）、Signs and rules（标志与规则）和 Sharing the road（共享道路）。课程中穿插考核环节，最终测试共 30 题，及格线为 27 题。年满 15 岁 11 个月即可报名，这样你在 16 岁生日当天就可以领取学习驾照。PrepL 目前还不是必修的：在它成为必修之前，你可以任选一种途径。让别人代做你的 PrepL，可能导致你的报名被取消、代做者被处以超过 $6,900 的罚款，而且你要等 6 个月才能重新报名。我们的指南对<t0>纸质笔试和 PrepL 做了逐项对比</t0>。

8227b8350747b9de.src: What does the Queensland learner test cover?
8227b8350747b9de.t: 昆士兰州学习驾照笔试考哪些内容？

a22d48c74b91cd55.src: The written test's second section is officially about road rules and driver licence requirements, so licensing rules (learner conditions, the logbook, P1 and P2 rules, demerit points and alcohol limits) are core content, not background. The rest covers signs, speed limits, traffic lights and road markings, alcohol and drugs, phones, seatbelts and child restraints, parking, and sharing the road. The handbook says learners are tested in detail on giving way: unsigned crossroads and T-intersections, STOP and GIVE WAY signs, turning, roundabouts, merging, U-turns, driveways, buses and emergency vehicles.
a22d48c74b91cd55.t: 纸质笔试的第二部分官方定义为道路规则与驾照要求，所以驾照规则（学习驾照条件、驾驶日志、P1 和 P2 规则、扣分和酒精限制）是核心内容，而不只是背景知识。其余内容包括交通标志、限速、交通信号灯和道路标线、酒精和毒品、手机、安全带和儿童安全座椅、泊车以及共享道路。手册指出，学车者会被详细考查让行：无标志的十字路口和丁字路口、STOP（停车）和 GIVE WAY（让行）标志、转弯、环岛、并道、掉头、车道出入口、公交车和紧急车辆。

49fb70a7a174c0b8.src: The current handbook dates from 2022, so it doesn't include Queensland's 2026 e-scooter and e-bike law changes. The app follows the current rules.
49fb70a7a174c0b8.t: 现行手册是 2022 年版，因此不包括昆士兰州 2026 年关于电动滑板车和电动自行车的法规变化。本应用遵循现行规则。

111959e3dc187231.src: A few Queensland rules to know as a learner:
111959e3dc187231.t: 作为学车者需要了解的几条昆士兰州规则：

c46ca3be0b94daed.src: Your blood alcohol limit is zero, whatever your age.
c46ca3be0b94daed.t: 无论年龄多大，你的血液酒精浓度上限都是零。

027b93fd608a89b3.src: Your supervisor must hold an open licence for that class, have held one for at least a year, and sit beside you.
027b93fd608a89b3.t: 你的陪练人必须持有该类别的正式驾照（open licence）至少一年，并坐在你旁边。

9d833f2914c434db.src: L plates go on the front and rear of the car, readable from 20 metres.
9d833f2914c434db.t: L 牌要挂在车辆前后，在 20 米外能看清。

987423adad3ce7fe.src: No driver may hold a phone or rest it on their body while driving, even when stopped in traffic or when the phone is switched off.
987423adad3ce7fe.t: 所有司机在驾驶时都不得手持手机或把手机放在身上，即使在车流中停下或手机已关机也不行。

ae13d8b9b8a453bb.src: Four or more demerit points within 12 months suspends a learner licence for 3 months. Driving without a proper supervisor alone carries 4 points.
ae13d8b9b8a453bb.t: 12 个月内被扣 4 分或以上，学习驾照会被暂停 3 个月。单是在没有合格陪练人的情况下驾驶，就要扣 4 分。

f73d4d1a71d5bc02.src: Your learner licence lasts 3 years. If you are under 25, you need 100 hours of supervised driving, including at least 10 at night, recorded in a logbook; each hour with an accredited driver trainer counts as 3 logbook hours, for up to 10 hours of lessons. Every car learner, whatever their age, must pass the hazard perception test before the practical test, and can sit it after holding the learner licence for 6 months. The practical test comes after at least a year on your learner licence. Under 25s then move to a P1 licence (from 17); if you are 25 or older, you go straight to P2.
f73d4d1a71d5bc02.t: 学习驾照有效期 3 年。如果你未满 25 岁，需要 100 小时的陪练驾驶，其中至少 10 小时在夜间，并记录在驾驶日志中；跟认证驾驶教练学车，每 1 小时可记为 3 小时，最多计入 10 小时课程。所有小汽车学车者，无论年龄，都必须在路考前通过危险感知测试，持学习驾照满 6 个月后即可参加。路考要在持学习驾照至少一年后才能参加。未满 25 岁的人之后换领 P1 驾照（年满 17 岁起）；25 岁或以上则直接换领 P2 驾照。

c9a2568fbf0973de.src: How many questions are in the Queensland learner test?
c9a2568fbf0973de.t: 昆士兰州学习驾照笔试有多少题？

c584326f9e54aa4b.src: Both routes have 30 questions. The written road rules test has 10 giving-way questions (you need 9) and 20 road rules and licence requirement questions (you need 18). The PrepL final test has 30 questions and you need 27.
c584326f9e54aa4b.t: 两种途径都是 30 题。纸质交规笔试有 10 道让行题（需答对 9 题）和 20 道道路规则与驾照要求题（需答对 18 题）。PrepL 最终测试共 30 题，需答对 27 题。

755e4681abf1c111.src: How many questions can you get wrong?

8496f1f243a0d4f4.src: In the written test, 1 in the giving-way section and 2 in the road rules section; failing either section fails the test. In the PrepL final test, 3 in total.
8496f1f243a0d4f4.t: 纸质笔试中，让行部分最多错 1 题，道路规则部分最多错 2 题；任一部分不及格，整场考试即不通过。PrepL 最终测试总共最多错 3 题。

2cecc6aa52d65079.t: 在昆士兰州 PrepL 是必修的吗？

9e81d01cfe0889ed.src: Not yet. The Queensland Government says PrepL will replace the written test, but until it is made mandatory you can choose either route.
9e81d01cfe0889ed.t: 目前还不是。昆士兰州政府表示 PrepL 将取代纸质笔试，但在它成为强制要求之前，你可以任选一种途径。

6fc62b27ae2d3cd1.src: One fee, the same as the written test fee ($29.70 as at 1 July 2026), gives 12 months' access. If you fail the final test you can try again after 24 hours at no extra cost.
6fc62b27ae2d3cd1.t: 只需交一次费用，与纸质笔试费用相同（截至 2026 年 7 月 1 日为 $29.70），可使用 12 个月。最终测试不及格的话，24 小时后可以再考，无需额外付费。

e1f7ca7c0a3df545.src: South Australia's two routes to a learner's permit, the questions and pass marks for each, the rules you are tested on and how to prepare.
e1f7ca7c0a3df545.t: 在南澳考取学习驾照的两种途径、各自的题量和及格线、考查的规则以及备考方法。

e3979e31d11ffa92.src: To get a learner's permit in South Australia you pass the learner's theory test, in one of two ways. myLs is an online course that finishes with a 30-question test where you need 27 correct, and some questions have more than one right answer. The in-person test at a Service SA centre has two parts: 8 give-way diagram questions that must all be answered correctly, then 42 multiple-choice questions on road rules and safety, where you need 32.
e3979e31d11ffa92.t: 在南澳考取学习驾照（L 牌），需要通过 learner's theory test（学习驾照理论考试），有两种方式可选。myLs 是一门网上课程，最后是一场 30 题的考试，需答对 27 题，部分题目有不止一个正确答案。在 Service SA 服务中心参加的现场考试分两部分：先是 8 道让行图示题，必须全部答对；然后是 42 道关于道路规则和安全的选择题，需答对 32 题。

ad0e102b9cf810ea.src: SA learner's theory test at a glance (checked 30 September 2026)
ad0e102b9cf810ea.t: SA 学习驾照理论考试一览（2026 年 9 月 30 日核实）

77b7cb7ba48e4953.src: Learner's theory test, car: online through myLs, or in person at Service SA
77b7cb7ba48e4953.t: 学习驾照理论考试，小汽车：通过 myLs 网上考试，或在 Service SA 现场考试

5165303a5c930ab6.src: Part A: 8 give-way diagram questions, all must be correct. Part B: 42 multiple-choice questions, pass 32 of 42. On paper or a computer.
5165303a5c930ab6.t: A 部分：8 道让行图示题，必须全部答对。B 部分：42 道选择题，42 题中答对 32 题及格。纸质或电脑作答。

0f7bbc067dae42d2.src: Online course of about 4 hours, then a 30-question test in one sitting; pass 27 of 30. Some questions have more than one correct answer.
0f7bbc067dae42d2.t: 约 4 小时的网上课程，之后一次性完成 30 题的考试；30 题中答对 27 题及格。部分题目有不止一个正确答案。

f60cc5a216ac8f00.src: myLs from 15 years 9 months; the in-person test and the permit from 16
f60cc5a216ac8f00.t: myLs 年满 15 岁 9 个月起；现场考试和学习驾照年满 16 岁起

a469bb1bd7a4a10a.src: How many questions are in the SA learner's theory test, and what is the pass mark?
a469bb1bd7a4a10a.t: SA 学习驾照理论考试有多少题？及格线是多少？

d6a86d07e1f92981.src: The in-person test has two parts, taken in order. Part A shows 8 diagrams and asks who must give way in each. One give-way mistake means you can't go on to Part B, so the attempt is a fail. Part B has 42 multiple-choice questions on road rules and road safety, and you need 32, so you can afford up to 10 mistakes there.
d6a86d07e1f92981.t: 现场考试分两部分，按顺序进行。A 部分给出 8 幅示意图，每幅都要判断谁必须让行。让行题只要错一题，就不能进入 B 部分，这次考试即不及格。B 部分有 42 道关于道路规则和道路安全的选择题，需答对 32 题，所以这部分最多可以错 10 题。

e9ce28230c9ceddb.src: The myLs test is a single block of 30 questions with a pass mark of 27, done in one sitting without help. Some questions have more than one correct answer: a hint tells you when, and you only score if you select every correct option.
e9ce28230c9ceddb.t: myLs 考试是一整组 30 题，及格线为 27 题，须一次性独立完成，不得接受他人帮助。部分题目有不止一个正确答案：遇到这类题目会有提示，只有选出所有正确选项才能得分。

4532236618fdfd5f.src: myLs or the in-person test: which route suits you?
4532236618fdfd5f.t: myLs 还是现场考试：哪种途径适合你？

989584731c1b1479.src: myLs is the route South Australia recommends, but it isn't compulsory. You first set up your identity, photo and a mySAGOV account at a Service SA centre. The course starts with Your driving attitude, then Signs and rules and Sharing the road in either order, and finishing all three unlocks the test. One fee covers 12 months' access with unlimited test attempts.
989584731c1b1479.t: myLs 是南澳推荐的途径，但不是必修的。你需要先在 Service SA 服务中心办理身份核验、拍照，并设置 mySAGOV 账户。课程从 Your driving attitude（你的驾驶态度）开始，然后以任意顺序学习 Signs and rules（标志与规则）和 Sharing the road（共享道路），三个部分全部完成后即可解锁考试。一次性费用可使用 12 个月，考试次数不限。

685087a764b127dd.src: The in-person test is for people aged 16 or older. You book it, pay the fee each time you sit, and take it at one of the Service SA centres that run theory tests, so check which ones before you book. No list of test languages is published, so ask Service SA if you need help with English. Failing in person doesn't stop you switching to myLs.
685087a764b127dd.t: 现场考试面向年满 16 岁的人。你需要预约，每次考试都要交费，并在提供理论考试的 Service SA 服务中心参加考试，所以预约前请先查清是哪些中心。官方没有公布考试语言清单，如果你需要英语方面的帮助，请询问 Service SA。现场考试不及格，也不影响你改走 myLs 途径。

0da3393ac6707845.t: <t0>现场考试及学习驾照本身：</t0>年满 16 岁起。

e3cda2296531c1ea.t: <t0>P1 临时驾照：</t0>年满 17 岁起。

bbd53a101a0cc9a3.src: What does the SA learner's theory test cover?
bbd53a101a0cc9a3.t: SA 学习驾照理论考试考哪些内容？

801d3e64c2a0b88e.src: The Driver's Handbook says the test is based directly on its road rules and road safety sections, including the licensing chapters: learner and P conditions, supervising drivers, the log book and demerit points are core material. Giving way matters most, since it has a whole part of the in-person test. South Australian rules that catch learners out:
801d3e64c2a0b88e.t: The Driver's Handbook（驾驶员手册）指出，考试直接以其中的道路规则和道路安全章节为依据，包括驾照相关章节：L 牌和 P 牌条件、陪练司机、驾驶日志和扣分都是核心内容。让行最为重要，因为它在现场考试中单独占一整个部分。容易让学车者出错的南澳规则：

6e4d6d6299e2dd3b.src: <t0>25 km/h school zones:</t0> the limit applies whenever a child is in the zone. Near selected schools there are also 40 km/h limits on school days, from 8 to 9:30 am and 2 to 4 pm.
6e4d6d6299e2dd3b.t: <t0>25 km/h 学校区域：</t0>只要区域内有儿童，就适用这一限速。部分学校附近在上学日还设有 40 km/h 限速，时间为上午 8 点至 9:30 和下午 2 点至 4 点。

b66405f4248cd4d8.src: <t0>More 25 km/h rules:</t0> pass a stopped school bus, a stopped emergency vehicle with flashing red or blue lights (unless it is across a median strip) or a stopped breakdown vehicle with flashing amber lights on your side of the road at no more than 25 km/h.
b66405f4248cd4d8.t: <t0>其他 25 km/h 规则：</t0>驶过停着的校车、亮着红色或蓝色闪灯的停靠紧急车辆（除非它在中央隔离带的另一侧），或在你这一侧道路上亮着琥珀色闪灯的停靠道路救援车时，车速不得超过 25 km/h。

dc9f24f1fc1f5456.src: <t0>100 km/h cap:</t0> learners and P drivers must not exceed 100 km/h, even on roads signed 110.
dc9f24f1fc1f5456.t: <t0>100 km/h 上限：</t0>L 牌和 P 牌司机车速不得超过 100 km/h，即使在限速标志为 110 的道路上也一样。

88e39b6e1d794ae5.src: <t0>Phones:</t0> learners and P1 drivers may not use a phone at all while driving, not even hands-free, except to pay or show a code while stationary in a place such as a drive-through.
88e39b6e1d794ae5.t: <t0>手机：</t0>L 牌和 P1 司机开车时完全不得使用手机，即使免提也不行；唯一的例外是在得来速（drive-through）等地方停车时用手机付款或出示代码。

f18dc58f3df12266.src: Your permit lasts 2 years. A qualified supervising driver must sit next to you: someone who has held a full licence for that class of vehicle for the past 2 years, hasn't been disqualified in that time, isn't on a good behaviour condition and is under 0.05. Your own limit is zero, L plates go on the front and rear, and 4 demerit points, speeding by 10 km/h or more, or any other permit breach brings a 6-month disqualification.
f18dc58f3df12266.t: 学习驾照有效期 2 年。必须有合格的陪练司机坐在你旁边：此人在过去 2 年内一直持有该类车辆的正式驾照，期间未被取消驾驶资格，没有附带良好行为条件（good behaviour condition），且血液酒精浓度低于 0.05。你自己的酒精浓度上限为零，L 牌要挂在车辆前后；被扣 4 分、超速 10 km/h 或以上，或任何其他违反学习驾照规定的行为，都会被取消驾驶资格 6 个月。

9d2415fc7e57f46f.src: Before P1 you need 75 hours of supervised driving, 15 of them at night, whatever your age, and at least 12 months on your permit (6 months if you are 25 or older). You also pass the Hazard Perception Test and either a Vehicle On Road Test or competency-based training and assessment. P1 drivers show red P plates; P2 drivers show none. Under 25, P1 also brings a midnight-to-5 am ban and a limit of one passenger aged 16 to 20 (family excluded), unless a qualified supervising driver sits beside you or an exemption applies.
9d2415fc7e57f46f.t: 无论年龄多大，在换领 P1 之前都需要 75 小时的陪练驾驶，其中 15 小时在夜间，并持学习驾照至少 12 个月（25 岁或以上为 6 个月）。你还需要通过危险感知测试（Hazard Perception Test），以及 Vehicle On Road Test（路考）或基于能力的培训与考核（competency-based training and assessment）。P1 司机要挂红色 P 牌；P2 司机不用挂 P 牌。未满 25 岁的 P1 司机还不得在午夜至凌晨 5 点之间驾驶，并且只能搭载一名 16 至 20 岁的乘客（家人除外），除非有合格的陪练司机坐在你旁边或适用豁免。

1e72528a67a6af69.src: Every answer explained, with its handbook page or rule, in English and four other languages.

d611ce6dc8870549.src: How many questions are in the SA learners test?
d611ce6dc8870549.t: SA 学习驾照笔试有多少题？

af1e2fd609597c8d.src: It depends on the route. The in-person learner's theory test at Service SA has 50: 8 give-way diagram questions in Part A, which must all be right, and 42 road rules and safety questions in Part B, where you need 32. The myLs test has 30 questions and you need 27.
af1e2fd609597c8d.t: 这取决于你选择的途径。在 Service SA 参加的现场学习驾照理论考试共 50 题：A 部分 8 道让行图示题，必须全部答对；B 部分 42 道道路规则与安全题，需答对 32 题。myLs 考试共 30 题，需答对 27 题。

5e5521d87a38c634.src: In the in-person test, none in Part A and up to 10 in Part B. In the myLs test, up to 3.
5e5521d87a38c634.t: 现场考试中，A 部分一题都不能错，B 部分最多错 10 题。myLs 考试最多错 3 题。

ea86ca361dadebb6.src: Is myLs compulsory in South Australia?
ea86ca361dadebb6.t: 在南澳 myLs 是必修的吗？

e0080b02c247db12.src: No. myLs is the recommended route, but the in-person test is still available, and failing the in-person test doesn't stop you enrolling in myLs.
e0080b02c247db12.t: 不是。myLs 是推荐途径，但现场考试仍然可以参加，而且现场考试不及格也不影响你报名 myLs。

ce32b848f8c8277a.t: Learners Test Australia 里的题目是 SA 真实考题吗？

48c898f09cb69fb0.t: WA 学习驾照笔试练习：学习驾照理论考试

234eb07a751d0e3f.src: What Western Australian law says you need for a learner's permit, the rules the test checks, what comes next and how to practise.
234eb07a751d0e3f.t: 西澳法律对考取学习驾照有哪些要求、考试考查哪些规则、之后的步骤以及如何练习。

85e23bedfdce3903.src: In Western Australia you must show you know the state's traffic laws and safe driving techniques before a learner's permit is issued, normally by passing a theory test. You can hold a car learner's permit from 16, and it lasts 3 years. Independent guides describe the theory test as 30 questions with 24 correct needed to pass.
85e23bedfdce3903.t: 在西澳，签发学习驾照（L 牌）之前，你必须证明自己了解本州的交通法规和安全驾驶技巧，通常是通过理论考试来证明。年满 16 岁即可持有小汽车学习驾照，有效期 3 年。据独立指南介绍，理论考试共 30 题，需答对 24 题才能通过。

7d98dce356624b78.src: WA learner's permit at a glance (checked 30 September 2026)
7d98dce356624b78.t: WA 学习驾照一览（2026 年 9 月 30 日核实）

a0c7af363fb67a67.src: Show reasonable knowledge of WA traffic laws and safe driving techniques, normally by passing a theory test
a0c7af363fb67a67.t: 证明你对 WA 交通法规和安全驾驶技巧有合理的了解，通常通过理论考试来证明

6448fdcbd43610ba.src: 30 multiple-choice questions, at least 24 correct to pass (independent guides)
6448fdcbd43610ba.t: 30 道选择题，至少答对 24 题才能通过（据独立指南）

f088e291e0301765.src: In person at a department centre or regional agent; an online option is being developed
f088e291e0301765.t: 在交通部办事中心或地区代理点现场参加；网上考试方式正在开发中

063b1a49f917e98b.src: 16 for a car learner's permit (15 years 6 months for a moped-only permit)
063b1a49f917e98b.t: 小汽车学习驾照须年满 16 岁（仅限轻便摩托车的学习驾照为 15 岁 6 个月）

0b602302537d15eb.src: A licensed driving instructor, or someone who has held a licence for that kind of vehicle for at least 4 years
0b602302537d15eb.t: 持牌驾驶教练，或持有该类车辆驾照至少 4 年的人

cc45a5e414775974.src: No faster than 100 km/h, L plates front and rear, zero alcohol
cc45a5e414775974.t: 车速不超过 100 km/h，车辆前后挂 L 牌，酒精浓度为零

8d56679732cdd9ee.src: WA legislation, including the Road Traffic Code 2000
8d56679732cdd9ee.t: WA 法规，包括 Road Traffic Code 2000（西澳道路交通法规）

14a8d0b22e76efd5.src: How many questions are in the WA learners test, and what is the pass mark?
14a8d0b22e76efd5.t: WA 学习驾照笔试有多少题？及格线是多少？

b2e15b6b4b5befff.src: Independent guides, including the RAC's WA learner guide and driving-school guides updated in 2026, agree: 30 multiple-choice questions on a computer, with at least 24 correct to pass, so you can afford 6 mistakes. You sit it in person at a department centre or regional agent. An online theory test was announced in April 2026 but has no start date yet, so check the department's website before you book.
b2e15b6b4b5befff.t: 多份独立指南（包括 RAC 的 WA 学车指南和 2026 年更新的驾校指南）说法一致：在电脑上作答 30 道选择题，至少答对 24 题才能通过，所以最多可以错 6 题。考试须在交通部办事中心或地区代理点现场参加。网上理论考试已于 2026 年 4 月宣布推出，但尚未确定开始日期，所以预约前请先查看交通部网站。

561cd7ca6a4b7a75.src: The law requires reasonable knowledge of WA's traffic laws and safe driving techniques before a permit is issued, so expect questions on both. The app's practice test uses the same format, drawn from every topic; treat it as practice for the rules, not a copy of the official test.
561cd7ca6a4b7a75.t: 法律要求在签发学习驾照之前，申请人须对 WA 的交通法规和安全驾驶技巧有合理的了解，所以这两方面都会考到。本应用的练习测试采用相同的形式，题目覆盖所有主题；请把它当作规则练习，而不是官方考试的翻版。

66ee1ab4c2540e87.src: WA has its own road rules: what is different?
66ee1ab4c2540e87.t: WA 有自己的道路规则：有哪些不同？

360433e1f41cb218.src: Western Australia doesn't adopt the national Australian Road Rules word for word. Its road rules are the Road Traffic Code 2000, which follows the national rules closely but has its own numbering and some local differences:
360433e1f41cb218.t: 西澳并没有逐字照搬全国统一的 Australian Road Rules（澳大利亚道路规则）。西澳的道路规则是 Road Traffic Code 2000，它与全国规则非常接近，但有自己的条文编号，也有一些本地差异：

073a9962f980f4a2.src: <t0>110 km/h default:</t0> outside built-up areas, the limit where no sign applies is 110 km/h (50 km/h in built-up areas).
073a9962f980f4a2.t: <t0>默认限速 110 km/h：</t0>在建成区以外，没有限速标志的路段限速为 110 km/h（建成区内为 50 km/h）。

01b57ee3d5d23343.src: <t0>Keep left at 90 km/h:</t0> on multi-lane roads with a limit of 90 km/h or more, stay out of the right lane except to overtake, turn right or U-turn, or for a few other set reasons.
01b57ee3d5d23343.t: <t0>90 km/h 靠左行驶：</t0>在限速 90 km/h 或以上的多车道道路上，不得占用右侧车道，除非是为了超车、右转或掉头，或其他少数规定的情形。

46cc6eb54fe0906e.src: <t0>40 km/h past incidents:</t0> pass a stationary emergency, breakdown, tow or Main Roads incident response vehicle with flashing lights at no more than 40 km/h.
46cc6eb54fe0906e.t: <t0>经过事故现场限速 40 km/h：</t0>驶过亮着闪灯、停着不动的紧急车辆、道路救援车、拖车或 Main Roads 事故应急车辆时，车速不得超过 40 km/h。

25035e3e7a7de1c6.src: <t0>No hook turns for cars:</t0> only bicycle and e-rideable riders may hook turn.
25035e3e7a7de1c6.t: <t0>汽车不得钩形转弯：</t0>只有骑自行车和电动代步工具（e-rideable）的人可以进行钩形转弯（hook turn）。

db1d028990ca852c.src: Who can supervise a WA learner, and what are the learner rules?
db1d028990ca852c.t: 谁可以担任 WA 学车者的陪练人？学车者要遵守哪些规则？

f6cf7d4ef40bec7b.src: A learner's permit only lets you drive to learn, with a licensed driving instructor or someone who has held a licence for that kind of vehicle for at least 4 years. The law treats the person beside you as your supervisor. They must be under 0.05 (zero in a few special cases) and free of illicit drugs, and police can test them.
f6cf7d4ef40bec7b.t: 学习驾照只允许你为了学车而驾驶，并且须有持牌驾驶教练或持有该类车辆驾照至少 4 年的人陪同。法律将坐在你旁边的人视为你的陪练人。陪练人的血液酒精浓度必须低于 0.05（少数特殊情况下须为零），且体内不得有违禁药物，警察可以对他们进行检测。

d48f768fa02d5495.src: Never drive faster than 100 km/h, even where the limit is 110 km/h.
d48f768fa02d5495.t: 车速绝不能超过 100 km/h，即使限速为 110 km/h 也一样。

afc7d93604baa870.src: Show L plates at the front and rear: a black L on yellow, at least 150 mm square. You and your supervisor are both responsible for them.
afc7d93604baa870.t: 在车辆前后挂 L 牌：黄底黑字的 L，尺寸至少为 150 mm 见方。你和你的陪练人都对此负有责任。

d052f5dba169896e.src: Your alcohol limit is zero until you have held a licence for 2 years.
d052f5dba169896e.t: 在你持有驾照满 2 年之前，你的酒精浓度上限为零。

cd4e3473977d92b7.src: On 30 September 2026, WA had no learner-only rules on passengers, night driving or phones.
cd4e3473977d92b7.t: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，WA 没有专门针对学车者的乘客、夜间驾驶或手机使用规定。

894be6a88949bdc3.src: What happens after you get your learner's permit?
894be6a88949bdc3.t: 拿到学习驾照之后要做什么？

607b92ba0dab73ce.src: Under 25, log at least 50 hours of supervised driving, including 5 at night (sunset to sunrise), in an approved log book signed by your supervisor; from 25 there is no minimum. The hazard perception test comes next: under 25, once you are 16 years and 6 months old and have held your permit for 6 months; from 25, after 6 months on your permit. Under-25s can take the practical driving assessment from 17, after the hours and the hazard test; from 25, 6 months after the permit was granted.
607b92ba0dab73ce.t: 未满 25 岁的人，须在经认可、由陪练人签字的驾驶日志中记录至少 50 小时的陪练驾驶，其中 5 小时在夜间（日落至日出）；年满 25 岁则没有最低时数要求。接下来是危险感知测试：未满 25 岁的人须年满 16 岁 6 个月且持学习驾照满 6 个月；年满 25 岁的人须持学习驾照满 6 个月。未满 25 岁的人在完成时数并通过危险感知测试后，年满 17 岁即可参加路考（practical driving assessment）；年满 25 岁的人在获发学习驾照 6 个月后即可参加。

b42c5d17dfa0d03d.src: Red P plates (a white P on red) come first, for 6 months: no driving between midnight and 5 am except in limited cases such as work or study travel, and only one passenger unless one of them has held a full licence for at least 4 years, the others are immediate family, or you carry them for work. Green P plates (a white P on green) follow until you have held a licence for 2 years and are at least 19. Novice drivers are disqualified for 3 months at 4 demerit points in their first year, or 8 in their second.
b42c5d17dfa0d03d.t: 首先是红色 P 牌（红底白字的 P），为期 6 个月：午夜至凌晨 5 点之间不得驾驶（因工作或上学出行等少数情况除外），并且只能搭载一名乘客，除非其中一名乘客持有正式驾照至少 4 年、其他乘客是直系亲属，或你是因工作而搭载他们。之后是绿色 P 牌（绿底白字的 P），直到你持有驾照满 2 年且年满 19 岁为止。新手驾驶员在第一年被扣满 4 分，或在第二年被扣满 8 分，将被取消驾驶资格 3 个月。

5db8510f59c064a8.src: These are the rules in force on 30 September 2026, so check for changes before you book.
5db8510f59c064a8.t: 以上是 2026 年 9 月 30 日有效的规则，预约前请确认是否有变化。

0e1946fddeae57aa.src: How to practise for the WA learners test with Learners Test Australia
0e1946fddeae57aa.t: 用 Learners Test Australia 备考 WA 学习驾照笔试

a7719c165790be90.src: A 30-question practice test that mixes every topic, with 24 correct needed to pass.
a7719c165790be90.t: 30 题的练习测试，混合所有主题，答对 24 题及格。

38c0e94595194d4e.t: 在塔斯马尼亚州考取学习驾照的两种方式、网上考试的题量和及格线、考试内容以及备考方法。

805a89ffdb11a9a1.src: In Tasmania you get a car learner licence by passing the driver knowledge test (DKT). Most learners take the free Plates Plus online course first and then a 30-question online test, where you need 27 correct. Some questions have more than one correct answer, and there are no compulsory questions. You can also sit a standalone test at a Service Tasmania shop without doing the course, but its format isn't published.
805a89ffdb11a9a1.t: 在塔斯马尼亚州，通过 driver knowledge test（DKT，交规笔试）即可获得小汽车学习驾照（L 牌）。大多数学车者会先完成免费的 Plates Plus 网上课程，然后参加 30 题的网上考试，需答对 27 题。部分题目有不止一个正确答案，而且没有必须答对的题目。你也可以不上课程，直接在 Service Tasmania 门店参加单独考试，但其形式没有公布。

afca7692d46833da.t: 塔斯马尼亚州交规笔试一览（2026 年 9 月 30 日核实）

81858ba26420bb2e.src: How many questions are in the Tasmanian driver knowledge test?
81858ba26420bb2e.t: 塔斯马尼亚州交规笔试有多少题？

14603ef8444fdadf.src: The online test has 30 multiple-choice questions and the pass mark is 27, so you can get no more than 3 wrong. There are no compulsory questions, but some questions have more than one correct answer. Each question tells you whether it does, and you must select every correct option to get the mark. The test takes about 30 to 40 minutes in one sitting, and leaving part-way through loses your progress.
14603ef8444fdadf.t: 网上考试共 30 道选择题，及格线为 27 题，所以最多只能错 3 题。没有必须答对的题目，但部分题目有不止一个正确答案。每道题都会注明是否如此，你必须选出所有正确选项才能得分。考试约需 30 到 40 分钟，须一次完成，中途离开会丢失进度。

0a5b8125b3cd8e15.src: The standalone test at a Service Tasmania shop is a separate version of the test, but its number of questions and pass mark are not published. Tasmania's official information says people who skip the course are much less likely to pass. After a fail at a shop you can resit the next business day, or switch to the online course.
0a5b8125b3cd8e15.t: 在 Service Tasmania 门店参加的单独考试是另一个版本的考试，但其题目数量和及格线没有公布。塔斯马尼亚州的官方信息指出，跳过课程的人通过的可能性要低得多。在门店考试不及格后，你可以在下一个工作日重考，或改为参加网上课程。

558d9b66b802bf22.src: What is Plates Plus, and how does it work?
558d9b66b802bf22.t: Plates Plus 是什么？怎么进行？

94a6ae320b0cfad9.src: Plates Plus is Tasmania's official online course for new drivers and the recommended way to your learner licence. You enrol from 15 years and 11 months with a client ID, set up online through myServiceTas or at a Service Tasmania shop. The course takes about 4 to 6 hours in three sections; you can't skip content, and finishing all three unlocks the test. The course and test are free, you have 12 months from first enrolling to pass, and after a failed attempt you wait 12 hours. Once you pass, apply for your learner licence at a Service Tasmania shop within 12 months.
94a6ae320b0cfad9.t: Plates Plus 是塔斯马尼亚州为新手驾驶员提供的官方网上课程，也是考取学习驾照的推荐途径。年满 15 岁 11 个月即可凭客户编号（client ID）报名，客户编号可通过 myServiceTas 在网上设置，或在 Service Tasmania 门店办理。课程分三个部分，约需 4 到 6 小时；内容不能跳过，三个部分全部完成后即可解锁考试。课程和考试都免费，你须在首次报名后 12 个月内通过，考试不及格后须等 12 小时才能重考。通过后，请在 12 个月内到 Service Tasmania 门店申请学习驾照。

b1f1d6a1dfb2811d.src: <t0>Plates Plus course and driver knowledge test:</t0> from 15 years and 11 months.
b1f1d6a1dfb2811d.t: <t0>Plates Plus 课程和交规笔试：</t0>年满 15 岁 11 个月起。

dcc741a923f85a1b.src: What does the Tasmanian DKT cover?
dcc741a923f85a1b.t: 塔斯马尼亚州 DKT 考哪些内容？

cb64b8a76426add1.src: The course and test cover the road rules and the reasons for them, safe driving attitudes and behaviour (with a focus on speeding, seatbelts, fatigue, distraction, and drink and drug driving) and licensing rules. Tasmanian rules that often catch learners out:
cb64b8a76426add1.t: 课程和考试涵盖道路规则及其背后的原因、安全驾驶的态度和行为（重点是超速、安全带、疲劳驾驶、分心驾驶，以及酒驾和毒驾）以及驾照规则。常让学车者出错的塔斯马尼亚州规则：

ec984a2ce1926a37.src: <t0>Speed caps:</t0> learners must not exceed 90 km/h and P1 drivers 100 km/h, whatever the sign says.
ec984a2ce1926a37.t: <t0>车速上限：</t0>无论限速标志如何，L 牌司机不得超过 90 km/h，P1 司机不得超过 100 km/h。

ec54f2c3edcfd291.src: <t0>Gravel roads:</t0> outside built-up areas, the default limit on unsealed roads is 80 km/h.
ec54f2c3edcfd291.t: <t0>碎石路：</t0>在建成区以外，未铺装道路的默认限速为 80 km/h。

51c5896819a32ded.src: <t0>40 km/h zones:</t0> no faster than 40 km/h past a stopped or slow police, emergency or roadside assistance vehicle with flashing lights (unless it is across a median strip), or within 50 m of a school bus showing its warning sign and light.
51c5896819a32ded.t: <t0>40 km/h 区域：</t0>驶过亮着闪灯、停着或缓慢行驶的警车、紧急车辆或道路救援车时（除非它在中央隔离带的另一侧），或在亮起警示标志和警示灯的校车 50 米范围内，车速不得超过 40 km/h。

8454ead4bb23c64d.src: <t0>Turning at traffic lights:</t0> no faster than 20 km/h.
8454ead4bb23c64d.t: <t0>在红绿灯路口转弯：</t0>车速不得超过 20 km/h。

e42a6925651c2f1b.src: <t0>Double broken centre lines:</t0> in Tasmania you must not cross them to overtake.
e42a6925651c2f1b.t: <t0>双虚中心线：</t0>在塔斯马尼亚州，不得越过双虚中心线超车。

abc0a9a4e6322d37.src: <t0>Phones:</t0> learners and P1 drivers may not use a phone at all while driving, not even hands-free.
abc0a9a4e6322d37.t: <t0>手机：</t0>L 牌和 P1 司机开车时完全不得使用手机，即使免提也不行。

9780b976f03e1bf4.src: What happens after you get your learner licence?
9780b976f03e1bf4.t: 拿到学习驾照之后要做什么？

a9bb11731cea077c.src: Your learner licence lasts 5 years. You may drive only with a supervising driver next to you: someone who has held a full licence for the past 12 months without a break. Show L plates at the front and rear, keep your alcohol at zero and don't tow anything. Four or more demerit points within 12 months brings a 3-month suspension.
a9bb11731cea077c.t: 学习驾照有效期 5 年。你只能在陪练司机坐在旁边时驾驶：陪练司机须在过去 12 个月内一直持有正式驾照，没有中断。车辆前后要挂 L 牌，酒精浓度须保持为零，并且不得拖带任何东西。12 个月内被扣 4 分或以上，驾照会被暂停 3 个月。

7e8b9fd2cee67e5d.src: You must hold your learner licence for at least 12 months in a row before P1, whatever your age, and log at least 80 hours of driving, 15 of them at night. The Hazard Perception Test can be sat from 3 months before the earliest test date printed on your licence: it has 25 video clips, you need 13 right, it's free and you can retry straight away. Pass it before you book the P1 driving assessment.
7e8b9fd2cee67e5d.t: 无论年龄多大，换领 P1 前都必须连续持有学习驾照至少 12 个月，并记录至少 80 小时的驾驶，其中 15 小时在夜间。危险感知测试（Hazard Perception Test）可以在你驾照上印的最早考试日期前 3 个月开始参加：共 25 段视频短片，需答对 13 段，免费，不及格可立即重考。请在预约 P1 路考前先通过这项测试。

25c7f7cbb7f2bc92.src: On P1 you show red P plates for at least 12 months and may carry no more than one passenger aged 16 to 21, unless an exemption applies (for example for family). Some P1 offences, such as speeding by 10 km/h or more, restart your P1 year. P2 brings green P plates, for 2 years if you are under 23, so the earliest age for a full licence is 20.
25c7f7cbb7f2bc92.t: 持 P1 期间，你要挂红色 P 牌至少 12 个月，并且最多只能搭载一名 16 至 21 岁的乘客，除非适用豁免（例如家人）。某些 P1 违规行为（例如超速 10 km/h 或以上）会让你的 P1 一年期重新计算。P2 阶段挂绿色 P 牌，未满 23 岁的人为期 2 年，所以最早 20 岁可以拿到正式驾照。

1f749323d87184ed.src: How many questions are in the Tasmanian learners test?
1f749323d87184ed.t: 塔斯马尼亚州学习驾照笔试有多少题？

3d6373f6d4ecead4.t: 不收费。无论在网上还是在 Service Tasmania 门店，课程和交规笔试都是免费的。通过后再缴纳学习驾照费。

37522169eb444584.src: The test is computerised: 35 multiple-choice questions drawn at random from a bank of more than 300. You need at least 31 correct, so you can't pass with more than 4 wrong. That is the minimum rather than the whole rule: the ACT doesn't publish every detail of how the test is marked, so treat every topic as one you need to know. The course fee covers two attempts at each test, and the provider can charge for more.
37522169eb444584.t: 考试在电脑上进行：35 道选择题，从 300 多道题的题库中随机抽取。你至少需要答对 31 题，所以错 4 题以上就无法通过。这只是最低要求，而不是完整的规则：ACT 没有公布评分方式的全部细节，所以每个主题都要认真掌握。课程费用包含每项考试的两次机会，超出部分课程提供方可以另行收费。

662221c2304cf353.src: How does the ACT course work?

c3b9485b923eb24b.src: There is no test at Access Canberra offices. You enrol in an approved course with an approved provider, or with your school if it runs the course for its students (some offer it free in Year 10). You finish the course modules and a course quiz, where you need at least 50%, then sit the knowledge test, supervised by the provider. An accredited interpreter can interpret but can't help you answer. No list of test languages is published.
c3b9485b923eb24b.t: Access Canberra 办事处不提供这项考试。你需要向认可的课程提供方报名参加认可课程；如果你的学校为本校学生开办该课程，也可以通过学校报名（有些学校在 10 年级免费提供）。你要完成课程各单元和一次课程测验（至少需取得 50% 的成绩），然后在课程提供方的监考下参加交规笔试。认证口译员可以提供口译，但不能帮你作答。官方没有公布考试语言清单。

abab55f72abed15f.src: When you pass, you get a completion certificate. Within 2 years, take it with your identity and residency documents to an Access Canberra Service Centre, pass an eye test and pay the fee. You'll receive a logbook and L plates.
abab55f72abed15f.t: 通过后，你会获得一份结业证书。请在 2 年内带上证书以及身份和居住证明文件，前往 Access Canberra Service Centre（服务中心），通过视力检查并缴费。你会领到驾驶日志和 L 牌。

64734c13170f16ad.src: What does the ACT knowledge test cover?
64734c13170f16ad.t: ACT 交规笔试考哪些内容？

e64d1de6b0c28b98.src: The knowledge test is about road rules, including the ACT's licensing rules. Rules that set the ACT apart:
e64d1de6b0c28b98.t: 交规笔试考的是道路规则，包括 ACT 的驾照规则。ACT 与众不同的规则有：

2e99f1c692212f98.src: <t0>No learner speed or passenger limits:</t0> ACT learners follow the normal speed limits, may carry passengers and have no high-powered car ban, as long as the supervisor sits next to them.
2e99f1c692212f98.t: <t0>学车者没有车速或乘客限制：</t0>只要陪练人坐在旁边，ACT 学车者按正常限速行驶，可以搭载乘客，也没有禁止驾驶高性能车辆的规定。

ac0b82fed4ca113a.src: <t0>L plates:</t0> at the front and rear, or on the roof.
ac0b82fed4ca113a.t: <t0>L 牌：</t0>挂在车辆前后，或装在车顶。

0853d6e9a05d2159.src: <t0>Supervisors at zero:</t0> your supervisor needs a full Australian car licence (no minimum number of years), must have no alcohol at all and must not drink while supervising.
0853d6e9a05d2159.t: <t0>陪练人酒精浓度须为零：</t0>你的陪练人须持有澳大利亚小汽车正式驾照（没有最低持照年限要求），体内不得有任何酒精，陪练期间也不得饮酒。

57cdd0259f8a7370.src: <t0>Phones:</t0> learners and all P drivers, P2 included, may not make calls at all, not even hands-free or by voice command.
57cdd0259f8a7370.t: <t0>手机：</t0>L 牌司机和所有 P 牌司机（包括 P2）完全不得打电话，即使用免提或语音指令也不行。

6ccf8fe10e4dcf92.src: <t0>40 km/h past emergency vehicles:</t0> pass a stopped or slow police or emergency vehicle with flashing red or blue lights at no more than 40 km/h, unless it is across a median strip.
6ccf8fe10e4dcf92.t: <t0>经过紧急车辆限速 40 km/h：</t0>驶过亮着红色或蓝色闪灯、停着或缓慢行驶的警车或紧急车辆时，车速不得超过 40 km/h，除非它在中央隔离带的另一侧。

5ef3a6b8c92f30e2.src: <t0>Light rail:</t0> Canberra's light rail vehicles count as trams under the road rules.
5ef3a6b8c92f30e2.t: <t0>轻轨：</t0>根据道路规则，堪培拉的轻轨列车视同有轨电车。

c3219a5434bc68b3.src: Your learner licence lasts 5 years. Hold it for at least 12 months, or 6 months if you were 25 or older when it was issued or last renewed. Under-25s need 100 hours of driving, including 10 at night, in the logbook; from 25 it is 50, including 5 at night. After 3 months, approved courses count towards the total: the Safer Driver Course for 20 hours (under-25s), the Vulnerable Road User Program for 10 and Learner Driver First Aid for 5.
c3219a5434bc68b3.t: 学习驾照有效期 5 年。须持有至少 12 个月；如果签发或最近一次续期时你已年满 25 岁，则为 6 个月。未满 25 岁的人须在驾驶日志中记录 100 小时的驾驶，其中 10 小时在夜间；年满 25 岁则为 50 小时，其中 5 小时在夜间。持照 3 个月后，认可课程可计入总时数：Safer Driver Course（安全驾驶课程）计 20 小时（限未满 25 岁），Vulnerable Road User Program（弱势道路使用者课程）计 10 小时，Learner Driver First Aid（学车者急救课程）计 5 小时。

cafb8bc2958d469d.src: After more than 3 months on your learner licence you can sit the online Hazard Perception Test. Then, from 17, you take a one-off driving assessment or competency-based training and assessment with an accredited instructor.
cafb8bc2958d469d.t: 持学习驾照超过 3 个月后，你可以参加网上危险感知测试（Hazard Perception Test）。之后，年满 17 岁时，你可以参加一次性路考，或跟认证教练进行基于能力的培训与考核（competency-based training and assessment）。

07db4b957ec3f34e.src: The provisional licence lasts 3 years: under 25 at issue, 12 months on P1 (red P plates), then P2 (green P plates); from 25, P2 throughout. Between 11 pm and 5 am a P1 driver may carry no more than one passenger aged 16 to 22 who isn't family, unless travelling for work or study. Four demerit points within 3 years, on L or P plates, brings a 3-month suspension.
07db4b957ec3f34e.t: 临时驾照（P 牌）有效期 3 年：签发时未满 25 岁的人，先持 P1（红色 P 牌）12 个月，然后转为 P2（绿色 P 牌）；年满 25 岁的人全程为 P2。晚上 11 点至凌晨 5 点之间，P1 司机最多只能搭载一名 16 至 22 岁的非家人乘客，除非是因工作或学习出行。持 L 牌或 P 牌期间，3 年内被扣 4 分，驾照会被暂停 3 个月。

99dcdb73ef5c265e.t: 小汽车（C 类）学习驾照的 driver knowledge test（理论考试）

359f4b283540a81c.src: 30 multiple choice, drawn at random from a pool of more than 300
359f4b283540a81c.t: 30 道选择题，从 300 多道题中随机抽取

a2b6c027ee1d0d81.src: An MVR office during its theory test hours; in remote areas, a local police station or the DriveSafe NT remote program
a2b6c027ee1d0d81.t: 在 MVR 办事处的理论考试时段内参加；偏远地区可在当地警察局或通过 DriveSafe NT 偏远地区项目参加

7bff57e796fe5d0e.src: Sections, time limit, paper or computer, and retry rules
7bff57e796fe5d0e.t: 分部分情况、时间限制、纸质还是电脑作答，以及重考规则

088c76e1bb884217.src: None in the NT: your response to hazards is assessed in the practical test
088c76e1bb884217.t: NT 没有这项测试：你对危险情况的反应会在路考中评估

85e28f7ce1b41277.src: How many questions are in the NT driver knowledge test?
85e28f7ce1b41277.t: NT 交规笔试有多少题？

bb23abb1a234c784.src: Thirty, all multiple choice and all about NT road rules, picked at random from a pool of more than 300. You need 26 correct, so 4 wrong answers is the most you can afford. There is one overall pass mark: the NT doesn't mention separate sections, and it doesn't publish whether any question must be answered correctly, whether there is a time limit, or whether the test is on paper or a computer. Retry rules aren't published either, so ask MVR if you need to resit.
bb23abb1a234c784.t: 30 题，全部是关于 NT 道路规则的选择题，从 300 多道题中随机抽取。你需要答对 26 题，所以最多只能错 4 题。考试只有一个总及格线：NT 没有提到分部分，也没有公布是否有必须答对的题目、是否有时间限制，或考试是纸质还是电脑作答。重考规则同样没有公布，如需重考请询问 MVR。

ed806530c25c907e.src: Where do you sit the NT learners test?
ed806530c25c907e.t: 在哪里参加 NT 学习驾照笔试？

7961300b6f23428b.src: At an MVR office, during its theory test hours, which end before the office closes. Bring evidence of your identity and NT residency, plus a completed learner licence application. In remote areas you can sit the test at your local police station or through the DriveSafe NT remote program. No list of test languages is published, so contact MVR if you need help with English.
7961300b6f23428b.t: 在 MVR 办事处的理论考试时段内参加，该时段在办事处下班前就会结束。请带上身份证明和 NT 居住证明，以及填好的学习驾照申请表。在偏远地区，你可以在当地警察局或通过 DriveSafe NT 偏远地区项目参加考试。官方没有公布考试语言清单，如果你需要英语方面的帮助，请联系 MVR。

68dfde652f426e31.src: <t0>Driver knowledge test and learner licence:</t0> from 16.
68dfde652f426e31.t: <t0>交规笔试和学习驾照：</t0>年满 16 岁起。

0ba86001f77b9605.src: <t0>Provisional licence:</t0> you must hold your learner licence for 6 months in a row first, so the earliest is 16 years and 6 months.
0ba86001f77b9605.t: <t0>临时驾照（P 牌）：</t0>你必须先连续持有学习驾照 6 个月，所以最早 16 岁 6 个月可以申领。

54e25337f7601d00.src: What does the NT test cover?

4d36a56f44da90b5.src: By law you must understand the road traffic laws before you get a learner licence, so the test is about NT road law: the national road rules as the Territory applies them, plus its own licensing, speed, alcohol and phone rules. NT rules that often surprise learners from other states:
4d36a56f44da90b5.t: 法律规定，你在获得学习驾照之前必须了解道路交通法规，所以考试内容是 NT 的道路法规：北领地所采用的全国道路规则，加上北领地自己的驾照、车速、酒精和手机规定。常让来自其他州的学车者感到意外的 NT 规则：

8288ebe4965cef36.src: <t0>Higher default limits:</t0> 60 km/h in built-up areas unless a sign says otherwise, 110 km/h outside them, and 130 km/h on roads signed for it. Every NT road has a speed limit.
8288ebe4965cef36.t: <t0>默认限速更高：</t0>建成区内除非另有标志，限速为 60 km/h；建成区外为 110 km/h；有相应标志的道路为 130 km/h。NT 的每条道路都有限速。

04bdbf665a70e746.src: <t0>Learner and P caps:</t0> learners must not exceed 80 km/h and P drivers 100 km/h, whatever the sign says.
04bdbf665a70e746.t: <t0>L 牌和 P 牌车速上限：</t0>无论限速标志如何，L 牌司机不得超过 80 km/h，P 牌司机不得超过 100 km/h。

c39f8a43f342213b.src: <t0>Front seats:</t0> when a learner drives, only the supervisor may sit in the front.
c39f8a43f342213b.t: <t0>前排座位：</t0>学车者驾驶时，只有陪练人可以坐在前排。

e7662d260e187ac2.src: <t0>Supervisors:</t0> a supervisor must be over 18 and hold a full licence for that type of vehicle. They count as the driver for alcohol and drug laws and can be held responsible for the learner's offences.
e7662d260e187ac2.t: <t0>陪练人：</t0>陪练人必须在 18 岁以上，并持有该类车辆的正式驾照。在酒精和毒品相关法律中，陪练人被视为驾驶者，并可能要为学车者的违法行为承担责任。

7b5f107d5161b55b.src: <t0>Phones:</t0> learners and P drivers may not use a phone at all while driving, not even hands-free, unless the car is stopped out of the line of traffic.
7b5f107d5161b55b.t: <t0>手机：</t0>L 牌和 P 牌司机开车时完全不得使用手机，即使免提也不行，除非车辆已停在车流之外。

4df8418773c09c8f.src: <t0>Road trains:</t0> road trains up to 53.5 m long use NT roads, so leave plenty of room when following or overtaking one.
4df8418773c09c8f.t: <t0>公路列车：</t0>NT 的道路上行驶着长达 53.5 米的公路列车（road train），跟车或超车时要留出充足的空间。

224745cccb2cc959.src: After the test you pass an eye test at an MVR office (or bring a recent eye report from a doctor or optometrist) and pay the learner licence fee. The licence lasts 2 years. Show L plates at the front and rear, keep your alcohol at zero and stay at or under 80 km/h. Five or more demerit points within 12 months brings a suspension.
224745cccb2cc959.t: 考试通过后，你要在 MVR 办事处通过视力检查（或带上医生或验光师近期出具的视力报告），并缴纳学习驾照费。学习驾照有效期 2 年。车辆前后要挂 L 牌，酒精浓度须保持为零，车速不得超过 80 km/h。12 个月内被扣 5 分或以上，驾照会被暂停。

5ce3a9ae7f1aff4d.src: After at least 6 months in a row on your learner licence you can take the practical driving test, an on-road drive of about 40 minutes with an authorised driving examiner. There is no separate hazard perception test in the NT: the examiner assesses how you respond to hazards, along with observation, speed, road position, decisions and control of the car. If you pass in an automatic, your licence can be limited to automatics.
5ce3a9ae7f1aff4d.t: 连续持有学习驾照至少 6 个月后，你可以参加路考：由授权驾驶考官陪同，在道路上驾驶约 40 分钟。NT 没有单独的危险感知测试：考官会评估你对危险情况的反应，以及观察、车速、道路位置、判断和车辆控制。如果你用自动挡车通过路考，你的驾照可能会被限制为只能驾驶自动挡车。

5eaa1de448d543df.src: The NT has one provisional stage, with red P plates for the whole period: 2 years if you are under 25 when it starts, or 12 months if you are 25 or older. P drivers keep to 100 km/h, zero alcohol and no phone use at all. If you are under 25, zero alcohol continues for a while after your P plates come off. Keep a clean record on your P plates for at least 12 months and you may qualify for a free 10-year licence.
5eaa1de448d543df.t: NT 只有一个临时驾照阶段，全程挂红色 P 牌：开始时未满 25 岁为 2 年，25 岁或以上为 12 个月。P 牌司机车速不得超过 100 km/h，酒精浓度须为零，并且完全不得使用手机。如果你未满 25 岁，摘掉 P 牌后的一段时间内仍须保持零酒精。持 P 牌期间保持至少 12 个月无违规记录，你可能有资格获得免费的 10 年期驾照。

c46271ce59e7daa8.src: How to practise for the NT learners test with Learners Test Australia
c46271ce59e7daa8.t: 用 Learners Test Australia 备考 NT 学习驾照笔试

28ef7fe2e0c1d6a7.src: 30-question mock tests scored against the 26-question pass line.
28ef7fe2e0c1d6a7.t: 30 题的模拟考试，按 26 题的及格线评分。

70d72d8693a949d1.src: More than 380 original NT questions, written from NT legislation, including the Traffic Regulations 1999 and the Motor Vehicles Act 1949.
70d72d8693a949d1.t: 380 多道原创 NT 题目，依据 NT 法规编写，包括 Traffic Regulations 1999（交通条例）和 Motor Vehicles Act 1949（机动车法）。

25b9c8dd629cfe11.src: NT-only rules such as the 80 km/h learner cap, the front-seat rule, 130 km/h roads and the single red P stage.
25b9c8dd629cfe11.t: NT 独有的规则，例如学车者 80 km/h 车速上限、前排座位规定、130 km/h 道路，以及只有红色 P 牌的单一阶段。

cfe05d2f34532ce6.src: Every answer explained, with the rule it comes from.
cfe05d2f34532ce6.t: 每道题都有答案解析，注明出自哪条规则。

e970394eb99ca476.src: Read <t0>the give way rules every learner must know</t0> for the national rules the NT shares, and <t1>how to use mock tests and mistakes</t1> to plan your practice.
e970394eb99ca476.t: 关于 NT 采用的全国通用规则，请阅读<t0>每位学车者都必须了解的让行规则</t0>；规划练习可参考<t1>如何善用模拟考试和错题</t1>。

9fcf1f7e23504bb3.src: NT learners test questions people ask
9fcf1f7e23504bb3.t: 关于 NT 学习驾照笔试的常见问题

d044acf7ccd893db.src: How many questions are in the NT learners test?
d044acf7ccd893db.t: NT 学习驾照笔试有多少题？

599091bd02759969.src: The NT driver knowledge test has 30 multiple-choice questions, drawn at random from a pool of more than 300. You need at least 26 correct, so you can get up to 4 wrong.
599091bd02759969.t: NT 交规笔试共 30 道选择题，从 300 多道题中随机抽取。你至少需要答对 26 题，所以最多可以错 4 题。

6fa02be4ff800f72.src: Is there a hazard perception test in the NT?
6fa02be4ff800f72.t: NT 有危险感知测试吗？

64b3615fcba46380.src: No. The NT has no separate hazard perception test. How you respond to hazards is assessed during the practical driving test instead.
64b3615fcba46380.t: 没有。NT 没有单独的危险感知测试，而是在路考中评估你对危险情况的反应。

5435410d6b8e57dd.src: How long do you need to hold an NT learner licence?
5435410d6b8e57dd.t: NT 学习驾照需要持有多久？

d4618b459b934dff.src: At least 6 months in a row before you can be granted a provisional licence. If your learner licence lapses or is suspended, the 6 months start again.
d4618b459b934dff.t: 须连续持有至少 6 个月，才能获发临时驾照。如果你的学习驾照过期失效或被暂停，6 个月将重新计算。

a292be3617ab5bd4.src: What is the speed limit for learner and P drivers in the NT?
a292be3617ab5bd4.t: NT 的 L 牌和 P 牌司机限速是多少？

1273c56e3fea50a4.src: 80 km/h for learners and 100 km/h for provisional drivers, even on roads signed 110 or 130 km/h.
1273c56e3fea50a4.t: L 牌司机为 80 km/h，P 牌司机为 100 km/h，即使在限速标志为 110 或 130 km/h 的道路上也一样。

0954c6b7f03ae8a7.src: Are the questions in Learners Test Australia the real NT test questions?
0954c6b7f03ae8a7.t: Learners Test Australia 里的题目是 NT 真实考题吗？

b31786309dd9e2f0.src: No. They are original practice questions written for the app from Northern Territory legislation. The app is independent and not connected to the Northern Territory Government or the Motor Vehicle Registry.
b31786309dd9e2f0.t: 不是。这些是依据北领地法规专为本应用编写的原创练习题。本应用是独立应用，与北领地政府或 Motor Vehicle Registry（机动车登记处）没有任何关联。

85e248102e064619.src: This page restates Northern Territory legislation in plain English. It is not an official version of that legislation.
85e248102e064619.t: 本页用浅显易懂的语言转述北领地法规，并非该法规的官方版本。
